data.one_liner: Automatically create type-safe routing configurations using annotations and build_runner.
data.what_it_does: Katana Router generates type-safe routing and deep-linking configurations using build_runner and annotations. It allows developers to define pages using widget annotations and automatically wires them up into an application router.
use_when: You want type-safe navigation and parameter passing without string-based paths.
You prefer annotation-based page configuration combined with build_runner.
avoid_when: You want a pure runtime router without build_runner dependency generation.
You prefer standard declarative routing configuration via go_router.
strengths: Type-safe navigation and deep linking parameters.
Reduces boilerplate by generating route configurations directly from page widgets.
weaknesses: Requires build_runner code generation steps for updating routes.
Tied to the Katana ecosystem and specific annotations.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding katana_router along with build_runner and katana_router_builder as dev dependencies, then running build_runner.

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: You want official, declarative routing without code generation.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: You want an alternative annotation-driven type-safe router with its own feature set.
